QuestInfo.name: Gold Dragons and Red Tigers
QuestInfo.0: So Gong will tell you about each faction. Talk to him for more details.
QuestInfo.1: Gold Dragon is more focused on training the mind, to better control ki. Red Tiger is more focused on physical power and strength training.
QuestInfo.2: The senior apprentice of each faction in Mu Lung administers entry exams. Talk to them for your chance to join.
